name: Sideline Stagger
idea: From the sideline, your shooter runs off two screens in a row to catch and shoot.
why: A defender might sneak past one screen, but two in a row are really hard to get through. The shooter's defender gets stuck, and the shooter catches the ball with time to shoot.
tryit: Shooter: start low, then run shoulder to shoulder past each screen. Screeners: stand still and wide, one after the other. Inbounder: pass to the shooter's hands as they come off the last screen.

frames.say: {3} passes the ball in from the sideline. {4} and {5} stand one after the other to make two screens in a row, called a *stagger*.
{2} runs off both screens toward the ball. {X2} runs into {4}'s screen and gets stuck!
{3} passes in to {2}, wide open on the wing. {X2} is way behind!
{2} makes the three! Two screens in a row are twice as hard to get through.
